headlineFindings: Five distinct things are called agent learning: in-context reflection, retrieval memory, procedural skill libraries, supervised weight updates, reinforcement learning. They have different requirements and different truth conditions.
Reflexion reinforces 'not by updating weights, but instead through linguistic feedback' and stores reflective text in an episodic memory buffer (abstract).
Voyager uses an ever-growing skill library of executable code and blackbox GPT-4 queries that bypass parameter fine-tuning (abstract).
ExpeL extracts natural-language insights from past tasks and recalls them at inference without parametric updates (abstract).
Agent Workflow Memory induces reusable workflows and reports +24.6% / +51.1% relative success on Mind2Web / WebArena (paper claims).
DeerFlow's skill-evolution host supplies evidence, staging, checking, publication and recovery, but explicitly not the learning strategy, candidate generation or quality evaluation.
Real agent-RL stacks exist and are active (verl, SkyRL/SkyRL-Agent, rLLM, AgentGym/AgentGym-RL, SWE-RL, SWE-Gym, OpenHands x Snowflake), but all need open weights, GPUs and a verifiable reward.
The commonly cited AgentGym arXiv id 2501.08913 is wrong; it is a machine-generated-text detection challenge. Real ids: 2406.04151 (AgentGym) and 2509.08755 (AgentGym-RL).
Reward signals are gameable: random rewards improved MATH-500 by 21.4 points on Qwen2.5-Math-7B via GRPO clipping bias, and specification gaming can generalise to reward tampering.
Prompted self-correction without external feedback is not reliably supported; reliable external feedback is the condition that works (TACL 2024 critical survey).
The Forge repo already specifies a learning loop (craft-agent-operator + memory-ledger + evaluation) but its own status lines say the tables and policy are proposed, not deployed.
The deployed stack is L0: no episode/skill/eval tables, no token ledger, no craft MCP registered, 2 vCPU / 7.9 GB / no GPU, API-only model.
The only truthful buildable learning for Forge today is L1+L2 with supervised promotion: autonomous proposal, human-approved activation, regression-tested.

primarySourceReview.name: Reflexion
primarySourceReview.claim: reinforces not by updating weights but through linguistic feedback; reflective text kept in an episodic memory buffer; 91% pass@1 HumanEval vs GPT-4 80%
primarySourceReview.requires: retries, a feedback signal, an evaluator
primarySourceReview.doesNotShow: weight learning; reflection without external feedback
primarySourceReview.forgeConsequence: reflection is only worth adding where the deterministic gate report is the feedback

primarySourceReview.name: ExpeL
primarySourceReview.claim: gathers experiences across training tasks, extracts natural-language knowledge, recalls insights and past experiences at inference
primarySourceReview.requires: task pool, outcome signal, insight extraction, retrieval index
primarySourceReview.doesNotShow: per-task-family transfer guarantees; it is in-context
primarySourceReview.forgeConsequence: closest published template for the Forge loop; agent_lesson is an ExpeL insight store with evidence ids

primarySourceReview.name: Voyager
primarySourceReview.claim: automatic curriculum, ever-growing skill library of executable code, iterative prompting with environment feedback, execution errors and self-verification; blackbox GPT-4 queries bypass fine-tuning
primarySourceReview.requires: reset-able cheap observable environment, executable skills, automatic verification, curriculum generator
primarySourceReview.doesNotShow: that the same works in a destructive production editor
primarySourceReview.forgeConsequence: reuse the versioned skill-library pattern; do not transfer free exploration to production

primarySourceReview.name: Agent Workflow Memory
primarySourceReview.claim: induces reusable workflows and selectively provides them; offline and online; +24.6% Mind2Web and +51.1% WebArena relative success; fewer steps
primarySourceReview.requires: step-level trajectory capture, workflow induction, retrieval and selection
primarySourceReview.forgeConsequence: a Forge skill should be a workflow record, not prose advice

primarySourceReview.name: DeerFlow memory and skill-evolution host
primarySourceReview.claim: DeerMem is the default memory backend; OpenViking optional; facts are confidence-ranked and injected under a token budget; cognitiveStyle added; task_continuity adds task_note/history_search/history_read; skill-evolution host offers stage/check/commit/revert with fail-closed scans and PREPARED/APPLIED/NEEDS_REPAIR lifecycle
primarySourceReview.requires: durable DB, one POSIX host, shared local skill storage, security-scan model for auto-publication
primarySourceReview.doesNotShow: any learning strategy, candidate generation, quality evaluation or reward model
primarySourceReview.forgeConsequence: DeerFlow is a substrate; Forge must supply the learner and the evaluator

primarySourceReview.name: Mem0
primarySourceReview.claim: extracts, consolidates and retrieves salient memory; graph variant; LOCOMO gains; current README says single-pass ADD-only extraction and multi-signal retrieval, with benchmark scores reflecting the managed platform
primarySourceReview.requires: LLM for extraction, embedding model, vector store
primarySourceReview.doesNotShow: procedural skill memory or design quality
primarySourceReview.forgeConsequence: user/session memory layer only; ADD-only change supports append-only ledger design

primarySourceReview.name: Letta / MemGPT
primarySourceReview.claim: virtual context management across memory tiers with interrupts; document analysis and multi-session chat; Letta is f.k.a. MemGPT and active source moved to letta-ai/letta-code
primarySourceReview.requires: memory hierarchy, paging tool calls, persistence, reliable tool calling
primarySourceReview.forgeConsequence: use as the context-budget mental model; implement bounded typed retrieval rather than an agent paging loop for L1/L2

primarySourceReview.name: Graphiti / Zep
primarySourceReview.claim: temporally-aware knowledge graph; facts have validity windows and are invalidated not deleted; episodes are provenance; hybrid semantic + BM25 + graph retrieval; DMR 94.8 vs MemGPT 93.4
primarySourceReview.requires: Neo4j 5.26 or FalkorDB or Neptune, LLM and embedder
primarySourceReview.doesNotShow: procedural skills; the reference servers have no auth or prompt-injection protection
primarySourceReview.forgeConsequence: adopt bi-temporal lessons with episode provenance; do not expose reference servers

primarySourceReview.name: Self-correction limits
primarySourceReview.claim: no prior work demonstrates successful self-correction with feedback from prompted LLMs except on exceptionally suited tasks; reliable external feedback works; large-scale fine-tuning enables self-correction
primarySourceReview.forgeConsequence: reflection without a deterministic verifier is not a learning signal

primarySourceReview.name: Reward hacking literature
primarySourceReview.claim: random rewards can improve MATH-500 by 21.4 points via GRPO clipping bias on Qwen2.5-Math-7B; reward-model overoptimisation degrades gold performance; specification gaming generalises toward reward tampering
primarySourceReview.forgeConsequence: verifier outside the agent write scope; validate reward across model families; human held-out labels

rewardAndAcceptance.acceptanceFunction: accept = all required gates present and passing AND artifact hash exists AND format/dimensions/dpi/colourspace match contract AND rights recorded AND (human score >= 3 if taste claim)

scalarReward.note: efficiency and human terms are logged but not rewarded until reliability is at ceiling; caps prevent rewarding less work or busywork

rewardAndAcceptance.promotionRule: k >= 3 independent successes AND k/n >= 0.75 AND WilsonLB(k,n,1.96) > p0 + 0.10 AND no golden regression AND human approval (taste) AND version and catalogue pinned AND content hash differs from active skills
rewardAndAcceptance.smallSampleWarning: 3/3 gives WilsonLB95 about 0.44, below 0.5; the statistical guard forces larger samples or an explicit p0
demotionRule: 2 failures in the last 20 uses of that skill version
any regression on a golden the promotion run passed
a newer verified episode contradicts it (contradiction record, not averaging)
app version or catalogue hash changed (expire, do not carry over)
CUSUM on rolling failure rate: S_t = max(0, S_t-1 + f_t - k), trigger S_t > h

periodic gold human labels; stop when gold-human agreement drops

version pin plus expiry plus periodic golden replay

catastrophicForgetting.risk: reflective text lost with context turnover; irrelevant memory injected
catastrophicForgetting.control: bounded injection budget (DeerFlow fact default 2000 tokens; OpenViking example 12000 chars, top_k 8, threshold 0.25), confidence ranking, dedupe, expiry

catastrophicForgetting.risk: skill wrong after app or catalogue change; contradictory lessons
catastrophicForgetting.control: version pin plus expiry, contradiction records, periodic golden replay, keep superseded rows, no hard delete

catastrophicForgetting.risk: SFT overfits and degrades out of domain
catastrophicForgetting.control: per-task-family LoRA plus replay mix plus held-out OOD eval; SWE-RL abstract notes an SFT baseline degraded on average while RL generalised (paper claim)

catastrophicForgetting.risk: policy collapse, entropy collapse, over-optimisation, loss of prior skills
catastrophicForgetting.control: KL penalty, reward caps, curriculum (AgentGym-RL ScalingInter-RL), checkpoint eval gates, last-known-good weights

definitions.autonomous: agent chooses goals, curriculum and success criteria
definitions.supervised: human supplies or approves brief and acceptance criteria; agent chooses how
definitions.selfDirected: agent improves its own policy from its own experience without an external verifier

evidence.freePlayInSimulator: Voyager (Minecraft automatic curriculum); AgentGym/AgentGym-RL, SWE-Gym designed environments; safe only in a sandbox
evidence.selfDirectedInRealTool: no fetched source demonstrates it without an external verifier; prompted self-correction unreliable (2406.01297); not safe
evidence.supervisedExecution: Reflexion, ExpeL, AWM update memory not weights and rely on task outcomes; this is the Forge design
evidence.weightTraining: real but requires GPU, open weights, verifiable reward; not in stack

autonomy.answer: Free play is evidence-backed only where the world is cheap, reset-able and verifiable. A Craft production job is destructive, expensive, has rights and brand consequences and no automatic quality oracle. Forge should be autonomous in how it works and supervised in what becomes true: it proposes, the owner promotes.
